args.body: Use the current CATALOGUE-EDITOR-EXAMPLE-PLACEMENT lease and the committed live-checkout-comparison.json. If the checkout differs, save the standalone example and proposed insertion outside products/sites/ with the exact baseline condition that would permit integration. Close the applicable branch under valid ownership with a lesson. Preserve the existing intake and operator terms.
